arguments.sql: SELECT JRNL_NO, SUM(DR_AMT) AS dr, SUM(CR_AMT) AS cr, SUM(DR_AMT)-SUM(CR_AMT) AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY JRNL_NO HAVING ABS(SUM(DR_AMT)-SUM(CR_AMT)) > 0.001 ORDER BY JRNL_NO
SELECT l.JRNL_NO, l.LN_SEQ, TRIM(l.ACCT_CD) AS acct FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c.ACCT_CD)=TRIM(l.ACCT_CD) WHERE c.ACCT_CD IS NULL

SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(VEND_CD),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) AS vk, REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(INV_NO),'^0+','') AS ino, COUNT(*) AS n, ARRAY_AGG(INV_ID) AS ids FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT h.JRNL_NO, h.PRD_ID, h.POST_DT, p.STRT_DT, p.END_DT, p.CLOSE_DT, p.STAT_CD FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p.PRD_ID=h.PRD_ID WHERE (p.CLOSE_DT IS NOT NULL AND h.POST_DT > p.CLOSE_DT) OR h.POST_DT NOT BETWEEN p.STRT_DT AND p.END_DT ORDER BY h.JRNL_NO

SELECT i.INV_ID, TRIM(i.VEND_CD) AS vend, i.INV_AMT, i.STAT_CD, i.JRNL_NO FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i.INV_AMT < 0 OR i.VEND_CD NOT IN (SELECT VEND_CD FROM "APVEND") OR i.JRNL_NO NOT IN (SELECT JRNL_NO FROM "GLJRNH")

SELECT i.INV_ID, i.INV_AMT, h.JRNL_NO, (SELECT SUM(l.CR_AMT)-SUM(l.DR_AMT) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l.JRNL_NO=h.JRNL_NO AND TRIM(l.ACCT_CD) IN (SELECT TRIM(ACCT_CD) FROM "GLCOA" WHERE ACCT_TYP='LIABILITY')) AS ap_cr FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h.JRNL_NO=i.JRNL_NO WHERE ABS(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.CR_AMT)-SUM(l.DR_AMT) FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c.ACCT_CD)=TRIM(l.ACCT_CD) WHERE l.JRNL_NO=h.JRNL_NO AND c.ACCT_TYP='LIABILITY'),0) - i.INV_AMT) > 0.005
